assessment: This manuscript is a valuable study to understand regulatory elements in the early developing mouse cerebellum. The authors have generated important ChIP-seq datasets from embryonic and early postnatal mouse cerebellum. The authors use these data to convincingly identify enhancers in the developing cerebellum. The authors have also made their data and analyses available online in the "Developing Mouse Cerebellum Enhancer Atlas."
